item.title: Insert Nostalgia Here
item.description: Read Insert Nostalgia Here Me: "I have an all-in-one memory card reader you can borrow. It connects via USB." Corporate Guy: "That would be great!" I fish it out for him and hand it over. Corporate Guy: "Uh… none of these look right." Read Insert Nostalgia Here

item.title: Please, Ma’am, Carry On
item.description: Read Please, Ma’am, Carry On Customer: "Can you help me carry this?" Me: "Oh, sure. Are you just heading to the checkout?" I set down my handful of stuff I'd needed to put back on the shelf. Customer: "Oh, no. I still have some shopping to do." Read Please, Ma’am, Carry On

item.title: Being A Decent Person Sure Does Cut The Mustard!
item.description: Read Being A Decent Person Sure Does Cut The Mustard! As he squeezes the mustard bottle, the cap pops off, and a bottle of mustard is now coating my sandwich. The two workers are staring at it in horror. My friend and the people in line behind me are staring. Then I start laughing. Read Being A Decent Person Sure Does Cut The Mustard!

item.title: iNeed Free Stuff
item.description: Read iNeed Free Stuff Customer: "I'm soooo disappointed with my MacBook! It's slow… and ugly! And I don't like the keyboard." Manager: "We sell keyboards if you—" Customer: "—Yeah! I need a free Magic Mouse and keyboard to make it right!" Read iNeed Free Stuff

item.title: Someone Is Super Amped Up!
item.description: Read Someone Is Super Amped Up! The room is filled with amps mounted neatly into built-in nooks, all wired into an expensive, fully functioning demo system. Within ten seconds of getting in there, the guy starts yanking on one of them. Me: "Sir, those are connected." He ignores me and keeps pulling. Read Someone Is Super Amped Up!
